task: Close silent unevaluated compliance gaps across Trivy Operator scan scope (kube-system, istio-system, RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding), uppercase PSS specs, KISA control accuracy, and node PKI/kubelet hardening and verification.

events.summary: Touched GitOps Trivy/PSS/KISA/ghost-pod-reaper manifests, node provisioning/hardening scripts (01-prerequisites.sh, 02-init-cluster.sh, 02-join-control-plane.sh, 11-4b-apiserver-oidc-node.sh, harden-node-files.sh), verify-cluster.sh, docs (compliance-hardening.md, lessons-log.md), and regression tests (R297/R385 updates + new R388). Deliberately did not edit portal/ (owned by other lanes) and did not mutate the live cluster or node.

Verified live cluster, master-1 node, trivy-operator 0.27.0 chart tarball, and trivy-operator v0.25.0 Go source: (1) commit 25d69d98 excluded kube-system/istio-system, suppressing static-pod ConfigAudit/InfraAssessment reports while v0.25.0 pkg/plugins/trivy/image.go:187 + workload.go:355 allow skipping system-image vuln Jobs via excludeImages without affecting in-operator audits; (2) v0.25.0 resource.go:108,123 wires RoleBinding (ConfigAuditReport) and ClusterRoleBinding (ClusterConfigAuditReport, omitted by v0.25.0 pkg/compliance/io.go); (3) chart 0.27.0 PSS templates hardcode 6/12 lowercase avd-ksv-* IDs gated by compliance.specs; (4) kisa-compliance.yaml mapped KISA-ETCD-01 to KCV0004 (kubelet-https) and overclaimed KISA-NET-01/RBAC-01; (5) temporary read-only node-collector:0.3.1 Job on narwhal-master-1 (deleted) returned [] for PKI CMD-0019/0020/0021 (CMD-0020 also has upstream awk'...' typo), protectKernelDefaults, RotateKubeletServerCertificate, and tlsCipherSuites; master-1 stat showed 10/11 PKI .crt files at 644 while all control-plane/kubelet processes run as uid 0, and /etc/sysctl.d lacked 4 of 6 kubelet kernel-default sysctls.

Included kube-system and istio-system in trivy-operator.yaml with exact system-image excludeImages (preserving app waypoint proxyv2) and ghost-pod-reaper child-Job skipResourceByLabels; added RoleBinding,ClusterRoleBinding to supportedConfigAuditKinds; limited chart compliance.specs to CIS+NSA and added GitOps-owned uppercase AVD-KSV-* PSS specs (pss-compliance.yaml + wave-5 App); aligned kisa-compliance.yaml controls to real Rego checks; tightened PKI *.crt/*.key to 0600 root:root with narwhal-harden-node-files.timer for kubeadm certs renew (02-join-control-plane.sh sudo cat + 0600, 11-4b 0600); persisted 95-kubelet-kernel-defaults.conf and enabled protectKernelDefaults=true + 6 PFS AEAD tlsCipherSuites in 02-init-cluster.sh (keeping serverTLSBootstrap false without CSR approver); expanded verify_node_file_hardening and added R388 + docs Scan coverage.
